propositions: reconcile_check performs vendor-specific comparison logic by lazy-loading Jira adapters and calling vendor-specific functions, creating a second undocumented backend reach-through that violates backend neutrality

the current implementation uses raw vendor payloads and vendor-specific field extraction (_assignee_matches, _extract_jira_field, fit_text_to_adf_limit) instead of canonical mappers, causing incorrect discrepancy detection on non-Jira backends

canonicalizing the snapshot entry via InboundMapper.map_remote_to_local and comparing in local vocabulary aligns reconcile_check with the canonical-differ principle and eliminates the backend reach-through
the AC1 neutrality gate must detect both adapters.jira imports (via AST) and by-path loads of adapters/jira/* files (via source-text scanning) to fully prevent vendor sibling loads in reconcile_check
annotation-label handling (rebar-status:blocked/cancelled precedence) should apply canonical mapper logic, creating an intended correctness improvement over raw Jira status comparison
